Aisha Patel: Morning — quick check-in for the runtime kernel/batching/KV work.
What I did: landed the memcpy-reduction hotfix in the attention kernel, kicked off perf runs for seq_len=1024 batch=4.
Blockers: seeing ~12% p99 regression on short responses after the patch, and a handful of KV cache evictions for long chat sessions.
Today: iterate on kernel memory paths, try dynamic batch cap, open canary for the fix. Pinging for CR review on PR #3421. @Chen can you re-run with kv_policy=sticky? @Marta any concerns on the batching window?

Chen Li: Re-ran overnight with kv_policy=sticky + quantized kernels. Mean latency improved ~8%, p99 still +6% vs our baseline. I uploaded logs to ./bench/20260317/run-09.log. Can re-run with batch_size=2 next.

Sam: Took a look at #3421 — small comment nits, otherwise LGTM. CI has a flaky test: runtime::kv_cache_test::eviction_order failing intermittently. I'll try to reproduce locally after standup.

Marta: Noted. Also observed an uptick in CPU sys for the batching coordinator when last_task_wait > 2ms — suggests the coordinator is spinning. Recommend lowering batching window for c10 machines on latency-tier routes. Also routing policy should prefer smaller batches for low-latency customers.

Aisha Patel: Thanks. Plan: Chen, please run batch=2 with kv_policy=sticky and attach results. Sam, paste the CI failure snippet here. Marta, I'll prepare a canary config to cap batching window for low-latency routes.

oncall-bot: deploy-canary started for commit ab12c3f (Aisha Patel). Monitoring new kernel in us-west-2. Will report back in 15m :eyes:

Chen Li: Re-run finished (batch=2, kv_policy=sticky, quantized). Summary: mean -5% vs baseline, p99 -2%, tail still noisy. CSV at s3://redwood-logs/bench/1768005123-summary.csv.

Sam: CI snippet: 
```
thread 'runtime::kv_cache_test::eviction_order' panicked at 'expected 3, got 4', runtime/tests/kv_cache.rs:123
```
I'll try to reproduce; looks like eviction ordering nondeterminism when two sessions free at the same tick.

Marta: FYI — I've scheduled a stress perf run for the spike workload at 1:00 PM PT. Please avoid non-urgent kernel changes between 12:45-13:15. I'll monitor batching coordinator and tail latencies.

Aisha Patel: Great. Action items: Chen — push the batch=2 bench into the canary pipeline; Sam — debug the flaky eviction_order test and report root cause; Marta — watch the coordinator metrics during the spike. Will hold the broader rollout until canary signals green. Backchannel if anything urgent. :thumbsup:
